# Minimalist HUD — by nutellafish

Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3750502564 (item version 6)

The author's terms, from the workshop page and `readme.txt`: "you can copy anything in this mod".
Included here: `screens/hud.lua` and the 142 textures that differ from the game's own files
(cursors included); the rest of the mod's `textures` folder is identical to Forts 1.39.

Known issues listed by the author: the map editor has no button tabs at the bottom; probably only
works at 16:9; a game update can reset the UI folder; new badges added by the developers will not
show until the mod is updated; the game's HUD skin must be set to "Default".
